notes: Library Commission minutes 1974-97 (SFPL volumes minutesofregular1974sanf to 1997sanf; from 1974 the volumes cover two years). Curated: branch community rooms, murals, the Glen Park move to Chenery Street, the 1988 bond renovations of Park, Presidio and Sunset, Chinatown's reopening, renamings. Dated by meeting; 1990s volumes dated by the 'was held' line by hand.

coverage.remaining: Held: the Eureka Valley branch was dedicated to Harvey Milk in 1980 (1992-10-06 resolution); no page (see branch-libraries-1954-1974). Not used: the 1982 Lowell Martin report votes to close or repurpose branches (Western Addition, Portola), which did not take effect; the 1994 request to rename the Merced branch (no outcome in the minutes); Potrero, Excelsior and Western Addition mural proposals with no completion recorded; Portola's 1995 rededication.

findings.description: The Library Commission's Extension Committee recommended moving the Glen Park Branch Library here, to 653 Chenery Street, at $400 a month with three one-year options, provided the building could be renovated for the library.
